falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured VIX peaking at 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained elevated fear would indicate this is not a similar capitulation bottom but rather the start of a deeper liquidation phase, invalidating the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom held at 4,116 with immediate reversal; a break below 4,150 would violate the structural support zone that defined that bottom, proving the current structure is weaker and the pattern match is false

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is simultaneously down more than 2% week-over-week
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug occurred with yields stable/rising (growth scare, not recession panic); this flight-to-quality divergence would signal recession pricing rather than soft-landing correction, invalidating the macro regime similarity

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
